Mike Bost highlights agricultural advocacy and anti-fraud efforts in October social media posts
Rep. Mike Bost posted on X about receiving an agricultural award and introducing legislation for family farms on October 14-15, 2026.
Rep. Mike Bost, U.S. Congressman representing Illinois’ 12th district since 2015, shared a series of posts on X (formerly Twitter) in mid-October 2026 highlighting his recent legislative efforts and recognition in the agricultural sector.
On October 14, 2026, Bost announced receiving an award from AgriBank during a meeting with Farm Credit Illinois in New Athens. He stated, "I was honored to receive the AgriBank Friend of Agriculture Award during my meeting with Farm Credit Illinois in New Athens! Agriculture is the backbone of Southern Illinois, and I’ll never stop fighting to ensure our hardworking farmers have the resources, opportunities, and https://t.co/njP4OO6VLL".
Later that day, Bost addressed regulatory issues facing family farms. He wrote, "Family farms are often passed down from one generation to the next. Outdated Washington regulations shouldn't stand in the way. That's why I introduced the bipartisan USDA Loan Modernization Act to cut red tape and help family farmers access the financing they need to keep" (October 14, 2026).
On October 15, Bost turned his attention to federal oversight and financial accountability: "It’s no secret that waste, fraud, and abuse has run rampant in Washington over the last several decades. But since 2025, the Trump administration has uncovered an estimated $260.7 BILLION in fraud. Every stolen dollar is a dollar taken from the hardworking Americans who earned".
Bost has maintained his seat through multiple election cycles since first replacing Gerald Hawkins in Congress in 2015. In recent elections he won by significant margins—including defeating Chip Markel with over 75% of votes in 2022—and has consistently positioned himself as an advocate for agriculture and fiscal responsibility within his district.
